How to read this

Orange = tiles whose removal LOWERS his predicted MammaPrint index (they drive risk up; his attribution, level-2 grid). White = where our grade MIL put attention (1 = an equal share, 128 = 10x, 255 = 100x). Green = tiles both models rank in their slide's top 10% -- the two heat scales are not comparable, so judge agreement by the green layer and the per-card rho, not by colour. The overlay is where the grade head *looked*, not where the tumour is: the tumour-vs-stroma contrast measured 0.48 AUC (below chance, REPORT.md §10).
